text:
The change modifies OSPF timers on one CPK interface and one PIT interface (presumably the CPK-PIT link), and removes BFD. Hello/dead intervals must match on both ends for the adjacency to stay up, and the timers here were changed consistently on both sides (5/20). The risks are adjacency flapping, slower failover now that BFD is gone, and collateral reachability or route changes.
